usedFor: Zagomail holds your subscribers, and Google Docs records them through “Add or Replace Text In Tab” when “New Subscriber” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscriber” in Zagomail, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A signup adds a line to a running subscriber document that your team can read.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so choose add for a running list.
